Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date.
data.explanation: This is a bill from an electrician for repair work carried out in your home. The full amount of 1,214.99 EUR is due within 14 days of the invoice date, without any deduction. Pay the stated IBAN by the deadline shown to avoid a reminder or late fees. Since this is a craftsman's service (Handwerkerleistung) performed in your home, part of the labor cost may be tax-deductible in your annual tax return — keep this invoice and, ideally, proof of a bank transfer (cash payments are usually not accepted for this deduction).
